column1: # Farming patches by area, read by FarmingPatchCatalog. An area is followed by its patches.
# Varbits are RuneLite gameval VarbitID names with their ids; tests check every name=id pair.
# Row types (tab-separated; "-" is empty or none):
#   area        name  owning region  bounds  alias regions (comma-separated)   bounds are defined in FarmingPatchCatalog
#   patch       patch id  label  patch type  transmit varbit
#   allotments  slug  first slug  first label  second slug  second label        two allotments, a flower and a herb patch
# Derived from RuneLite's FarmingWorld (master @ e98399f931c6, BSD 2-Clause; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
# Ids of the first (Phase B) catalogue are kept exactly: herb.<site>, allotment.<site>.<n|s|nw|se>, tree.<site>. Patch ids are persisted.
# "allotments" is the standard site: allotments on A and B, flower on C, herb on D (compost E not catalogued).
# Great Conch: the calquat only (its two coral nurseries, A and B, are not catalogued).
# The full 3x3 region area centred on the Farming Guild (big compost N not catalogued).
# All of Prifddinas, and all of Prifddinas underground (compost D not catalogued).
